abstract.para: The &ssg; for &productnameshort; 16 provides seven profiles in one data stream. In immutable mode, the rules of these profiles do not apply.

section.title: Profiles in the data stream
section.para: The data stream for &productnameshort; 16 is /usr/share/xml/scap/ssg/content/ssg-sle16-ds.xml. To list the profiles that it contains, run the following command:
section.screen: &prompt.user;oscap info --profiles /usr/share/xml/scap/ssg/content/ssg-sle16-ds.xml xccdf_org.ssgproject.content_profile_anssi_bp28_enhanced:ANSSI-BP-028 (enhanced) xccdf_org.ssgproject.content_profile_anssi_bp28_high:ANSSI-BP-028 (high) xccdf_org.ssgproject.content_profile_anssi_bp28_intermediary:ANSSI-BP-028 (intermediary) xccdf_org.ssgproject.content_profile_anssi_bp28_minimal:ANSSI-BP-028 (minimal) xccdf_org.ssgproject.content_profile_base:DRAFT General System Security Profile for SUSE Linux Enterprise (SLES) 16 xccdf_org.ssgproject.content_profile_hipaa:Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) xccdf_org.ssgproject.content_profile_pci-dss-4:PCI-DSS v4.0.1 Control Baseline for SUSE Linux Enterprise 16
section.para: The profiles cover PCI-DSS v4.0.1, HIPAA and the four levels of ANSSI-BP-028. The base profile is a draft general system security profile.

section.title: Immutable mode
section.para: In immutable mode, every rule of the &productnameshort; 16 profiles returns notapplicable. The &ssg; identifies &productnameshort; 16 by the SLES-release package, which immutable mode replaces with SLES_immutable-release.
